name: Convolutional Autoencoder for Volume Compression
aliases: Compressed Volume Rendering using Deep Learning
definition: A convolutional autoencoder network that compresses multivariate volume slices into a compact representation and reconstructs them, enabling real-time rendering of large time-varying volumes by storing only the compressed representation on GPU memory.
summary: It compresses volumetric data using learned non-linear features instead of fixed transforms, enabling interactive rendering with lower reconstruction error.
